turns_rupees: Hello Suresh garu, Ravi from the shop. I need forty bags of sona masoori rice for next week.
Forty bags, fine. Fourteen fifty rupees a bag. I can deliver on Friday morning.
Fourteen fifty is okay. I'll send fourteen thousand rupees as advance by Thursday.
Good. And I'll take care of the transport, five hundred rupees, don't worry about that.
Thank you. Please send the bill by Wednesday, I want to check it first.
I'll send it. Also, keep three empty sacks ready, I'll take them back.
Okay, I'll keep them ready. And the balance, I'll pay on delivery.
hint: A shop call in India. Prices are in Indian rupees: fourteen fifty means one thousand four hundred and fifty rupees.
